'''The Rising Moon''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. More expensive than either [[The Promenade (hotel)|The Promenade]] or [[Corestrike Hotel]], it was popular with corporate representatives, [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]], and those capable of charging lodging fees to expense accounts.<ref name="HNNA" />
